mapper.sql: id, request_id, user_id, payload_json, train_id, travel_date, seat_type, from_segment_index, to_segment_index, passenger_count, status, stock_reserved, published_at, order_id, order_no, fail_reason, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_request (request_id, user_id, payload_json, train_id, travel_date, seat_type, from_segment_index, to_segment_index, passenger_count, status, stock_reserved) VALUES (#{requestId}, #{userId}, #{payloadJson}, #{trainId}, #{travelDate}, #{seatType}, #{fromSegmentIndex}, #{toSegmentIndex}, #{passengerCount}, #{status}, #{stockReserved})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM order_request WHERE request_id = #{requestId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE order_request SET status = 1, stock_reserved = 1, fail_reason = NULL WHERE request_id = #{requestId} AND status = 0
UPDATE order_request SET status = 2, fail_reason = NULL WHERE request_id = #{requestId} AND status IN (1, 2)
UPDATE order_request SET status = 3, order_id = #{orderId}, order_no = #{orderNo}, fail_reason = NULL WHERE request_id = #{requestId} AND status IN (1, 2)
UPDATE order_request SET status = 4, fail_reason = LEFT(#{failReason}, 255) WHERE request_id = #{requestId} AND status IN (0, 1, 2)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM order_request WHERE status = 1 AND stock_reserved = 1 AND published_at IS NULL AND updated_at < #{updatedBefore} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
